name: Strike Lab Fighting-Game Training Arena
request: Create a small, playable Strike Lab fighting-game training arena for one player on desktop and touch. Include a humanoid training dummy, a three-hit light-attack combo with visible windup, contact and recovery animations, synchronized hit sound effects, a visible accepted-hit counter and dummy health. The server must validate attack timing and range. Each accepted strike damages and counts once at contact; swinging out of range, holding the button or spamming during recovery must not create extra hits. Show distinct hit and miss feedback. After defeat, reset the dummy and let the player practice again; provide a clear reset control and an uncluttered arena. Search Marketplace first for complete reusable combat/training components, compatible dummy rigs, existing animations and sound rather than rebuilding everything. Inspect compatibility, behavior and included media, preserve useful working pieces and author only missing integration. Source missing audio from Marketplace and verify actual playing animations and audible sounds. Record an importer capability gap honestly rather than treating it as a bad asset. Choose reasonable styling and damage values yourself. No PvP, matchmaking, saving, monetization or large world. Success needs native evidence for the full combo, exact counting, misses, recovery spam, defeat/reset and desktop/touch controls. A damage script with a static dummy does not meet the animation requirement.

assetNeeds.role: Humanoid training dummy with customizable target markers and health display
assetNeeds.constraints: R15 or R6 humanoid structure, unanchored limbs welded/motored to HumanoidRootPart, proper collision setup.

intent.experienceRole: Provides an interactive combat target for practicing timing, hit spacing, and combo execution.
intent.interaction: Reacts with hit flinch, highlight flash, audio impact, and ragdoll/knockdown upon reaching 0 HP.

assetNeeds.constraints: Clean impact punch/strike sound effect without background music, short duration (<1s).

intent.experienceRole: Delivers immediate tactile auditory feedback when a strike connects within the valid range and active window.
intent.interaction: Plays at contact moment on accepted hits.

assetNeeds.role: Light melee swing whoosh sound effect
assetNeeds.constraints: Subtle, quick whoosh sound indicating a swing through air without target contact.

intent.experienceRole: Provides clear auditory distinction between connecting on the dummy versus whiffing a strike.
intent.interaction: Plays when a swing is initiated or misses the target.

spec.assetStrategy: Search Roblox Marketplace for humanoid training dummy rigs, melee swing/impact sound effects, and standard combat animations. If external animations or rigs require adaptation, use standard R15/R6 rig compatible joints, programmatic procedural keyframing via Motor6D/TweenService alongside Roblox built-in sound assets and verified audio IDs.
spec.title: Strike Lab Fighting-Game Training Arena
spec.summary: Strike Lab is a focused single-player fighting-game training dojo designed for both desktop and touch platforms. Players spawn in a clean, high-visibility training ring facing an interactive humanoid training dummy with dedicated hitboxes, health metering, and hit counter tracking. The combat system features an authored three-hit light attack combo (Jab -> Cross -> Roundhouse Kick/Finisher) governed by a rigorous three-phase state machine (Windup, Contact Window, Recovery) with server-side validation for attack distance, cooldown timings, and single-hit registration per swing. Spamming inputs during recovery, holding attack inputs, or swinging out of range yields distinct miss feedback without inflating the combo counter. Defeating the dummy triggers a ragdoll/knockdown state and provides an immediate manual or automatic reset back to full health and ready stance. Responsive desktop keys and mobile touch controls ensure cross-platform playability.
spec.visualDirection: A modern, minimalist martial arts dojo / training sim with clean geometric floor markings, bounded neon-accented perimeter rails, and neutral overhead key lighting that eliminates distracting shadows. The humanoid dummy is styled with clear high-contrast impact zones (torso/head target pads) and a floating world-space health and combo gauge. Attacks produce crisp directional spark VFX and impact flash highlights on successful contact, subtle white swipe arcs on misses, and dynamic floating combat text indicating hit numbers and damage dealt.

-- ModuleScript: Package
-- Written by: @Quenty

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

local function SafeWaitForChild(ParentObject, ChildName, TimeoutDuration)
	-- Safely waits for a child instance to be available in the hierarchy
	-- Useful for handling replication delays and network latency issues

	if ParentObject == nil then
		error("Parent object cannot be nil", 2)
	end
	if type(ChildName) ~= "string" then
		error("Child name must be a string value", 2)
	end

	local TargetChild = ParentObject:FindFirstChild(ChildName)
	local StartTime = tick()
	local TimeoutWarning = false

	while TargetChild == nil and ParentObject ~= nil do
		RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
		TargetChild = ParentObject:FindFirstChild(ChildName)
		if TimeoutWarning == false and StartTime + (TimeoutDuration or 5) <= tick() then
			TimeoutWarning = true
			warn("Potential infinite yield detected in SafeWaitForChild(" .. ParentObject:GetFullName() .. ", " .. ChildName .. ")")
			if TimeoutDuration then
				return ParentObject:FindFirstChild(ChildName)
			end
		end
	end

	if ParentObject == nil then
		warn("Parent object no longer exists during SafeWaitForChild operation")
	end

	return TargetChild
end

local function RecursiveChildOperation(ParentInstance, OperationFunction)
	-- Recursively applies operation function to all children in hierarchy
	-- Maintains proper tree traversal order and handles nested structures

	OperationFunction(ParentInstance)

	for _, ChildInstance in ipairs(ParentInstance:GetChildren()) do
		RecursiveChildOperation(ChildInstance, OperationFunction)
	end
end

local function ApplyInstanceProperties(TargetInstance, PropertyTable)
	-- Applies property values and child objects to target instance
	-- Supports both direct property assignment and child object parenting

	if type(PropertyTable) ~= "table" then
		error("Property table must be a valid table structure", 2)
	end

	for PropertyKey, PropertyValue in pairs(PropertyTable) do
		if type(PropertyKey) == "number" then
			if typeof(PropertyValue) == "Instance" then
				PropertyValue.Parent = TargetInstance
			end
		else
			TargetInstance[PropertyKey] = PropertyValue
		end
	end
	return TargetInstance
end

local function CreateInstance(ClassName, InitialProperties)
	-- Factory function for creating instances with initial properties
	-- Streamlines object creation and property assignment process

end
